page_title: NAP 0-1 EMP | Napoli v Empoli 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.

90+5' Leo Ostigard (Napoli) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
90+5' There's an opportunity for Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

90+5' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+1' 0 - 1 Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball inside the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Napoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

89' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Etrit Berisha makes a great save. The ball is out of play and Napoli manage to earn a corner.
89' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Napoli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
88' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
86' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Mario Rui (Napoli) but poses no threat.
84' Here comes a substitution. Mario Rui (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for Mathias Olivera.
80' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) swings in a cross from the corner, but Etrit Berisha reads it well and gathers the ball.
80' Aurelio Andreazzoli has decided to substitute Matteo Cancellieri and he is replaced by Daniel Maldini (Empoli).
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alberto Grassi (Empoli) will replace Filippo Ranocchia.

79' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the top left corner, but Etrit Berisha makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! Napoli have a corner.
78' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
77' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
76' The ball is cleared after Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
75' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes a short corner kick.

75' Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the left post is blocked by Etrit Berisha, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Today's match ends for Matteo Politano who will be replaced by Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli).
72' Rudi Garcia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jens Cajuste (Napoli) replacing Frank Anguissa.
71' Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jacopo Fazzini.
70' Poor challenge! Matteo Politano (Napoli) is penalised for tripping and Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle. Empoli are awarded the free kick.
65' The free kick is delivered by Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
63' Aurelio Andreazzoli has decided to make a change. Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) replaces Bartosz Bereszynski.
63' Substitution. Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nicolo Cambiaghi walks off.
62' The resulting corner, taken by Matteo Politano (Napoli), comes to nothing.
60' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
57' Empoli take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
56' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Empoli win a corner.
54' The game has come to an end for Giovanni Simeone. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Piotr Zielinski (Napoli).
54' Rudi Garcia prepares a substitution. Eljif Elmas is replaced by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli).
52' Napoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
52' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Matteo Politano (Napoli) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee signals a corner kick to Napoli.
50' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
47' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) commits a rough challenge and Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle for an infringement.
46' A short pass finds Matteo Politano (Napoli). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle as Youssef Maleh (Empoli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
41' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
40' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Mathias Olivera (Napoli).
37' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
36' A quickly taken corner by Empoli.

35' Pierluigi Gollini was forced into action to thwart Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper. The ball is out of play. Empoli win a corner kick.
35' Empoli work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
35' Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Empoli will take a corner.
32' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Etrit Berisha.
29' Filippo Ranocchia (Empoli) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post.
28' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
27' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alessandro Prontera no option but to blow his whistle.
24' Alessandro Prontera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Liberato Cacace (Empoli).
23' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
18' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
16' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
13' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the top right corner is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
13' Matteo Politano (Napoli) will deliver the corner kick.

12' Matteo Politano (Napoli) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Etrit Berisha makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! Napoli force their opponents to concede a corner.
12' Half-chance! Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) plays a pass into the box, but Etrit Berisha reacts well to snuff out the attack.
10' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
7' Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Pierluigi Gollini intercepts the ball.
5' The linesman signals that Francesco Caputo (Empoli) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

5' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alessandro Prontera with no other option than to blow for a foul.
4' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Napoli will take the kick-off.
Alessandro Prontera is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
